findings.title: Root login from 203.0.113.9 right before sysbackup was created
findings.summary: auth.log shows a root SSH login from 203.0.113.9 one minute before useradd.
findings.recommended_action: Block the IP and rotate root's keys.

investigation.answer: sysbackup was created by root at 02:00:41 after a root SSH login from 203.0.113.9.
